# PROCESS — cand_0003 (parent = champion cand_0001, val 0.527)

Edit space this iteration: ONLY the system prompt (`prompt.md`). tools.py is NOT in the
editable artifact set, so every fix is a KNOWLEDGE / PROCEDURE prompt edit grounded in this
iteration's `./trajectories/` and the SpreadsheetBench exact-match grading (3 hidden files
per task, same layout, different data/size).

Diagnosis was fanned out to 3 read-only subagents (one per cluster-group) that parsed the
JSON traces, extracted per-trial code + reward, and compared passing vs failing trials.

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = tasks × trials × recoverable score, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | task(s) | root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Multi-key lookup returns wrong source row; failing trials zero out already-correct cells | 52216 (0.20; solvable — 1/5 passed) | User needs a row identified by TWO keys (region header A14 + row label A15/A16); trials matched one key, or matched a label against the wrong column, or read the region from a year-integer cell → all-zeros, clobbering the known-good row 15. | PROCEDURE | prompt step 3 (match-by-key) + step 8 (verify, don't clobber) |
| 2 | Output rows aligned by POSITION, not by the target sheet's own key column | 374-9 (0.27; fails hidden files 2&3 identically) | Sheet2 pre-lists state names; all trials copy Sheet1→Sheet2 by row position, so a reordered/ subset hidden file misaligns every row. Column detection + summation already robust; only row alignment isn't. | PROCEDURE | prompt step 3 (destination key lookup) |
| 3 | "Delete all blank rows" stops the scan at the first non-blank row | 347-49 (0.00) | Each gap is blank-block + a non-blank `Employee Info` label + a blank before the marker; trials halted at the label, deleting ~10 of ~60 blank rows. (t3 also never saved.) | PROCEDURE | prompt step 4 (delete every blank in span; label rows are content) + step 7 (always save) |
| 4 | Literal output format dropped leading zeros | 40467 (0.80) | Instruction shows `01-Jan`; failing trial used `d-mmm`→`1-Jan`; passing trials used `dd-mmm`→`01-Jan`. | KNOWLEDGE | prompt step 5 (reproduce shown format char-for-char) |
| 5 | Round-1 tool-call XML wastes a round | all failing/flaky tasks (0 in every passing task) | Agent emits `<function_calls><invoke name="computer">…` on round 1 → "No code block found", round wasted. 4/4 passing tasks never do this. | OUTPUT CONTRACT | prompt top block |
| 6 | Inclusive-window off-by-one (weak) | 32468 (0.00) | "including the subsequent 12 months" — trials summed a 12-point window; the `I40` note hints anchor + 12 = 13 points. | KNOWLEDGE (light) | prompt step 2 one-liner |
| — | Blank instruction (unwinnable) | 55457 (0.00) | instruction is a lone `\xa0`; intent unknowable. | SKIP | none |

## Changes made (one row per edit; all in prompt.md)
| cluster | edit class (skill menu) | where | what & why it generalizes | blast-radius class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1,2 | Add missing rule #4 | step 3 (new) | Match rows by key values, not position: (a) place each result on the destination row whose identifier matches; (b) when each output row needs a different source row, match EVERY uniquely-determining key (block header + row label) against the column that actually holds it. | BOUNDED — triggers only when a lookup/alignment is needed; 53161 already multi-key-matches (passes), 47484 already keys on A+B combo, 418-29 target has no pre-existing key column → untriggered. |
| 1 | Tighten output contract #8 | step 8 (new) | Re-open with data_only=True and verify answer cells; never leave known-good cells overwritten with 0/blank/#N/A. | BOUNDED — a read-back check; never changes a correct output. |
| 3 | Add missing rule #4 | step 4 | "Delete ALL blank rows" = every blank in the span; a non-blank label between data blocks is content to keep and does NOT end the scan. | BOUNDED — fires only when a non-blank row sits amid blanks; 160-6 (passing) has pure blank gaps, no interspersed labels → identical behavior. |
| 3 | Add missing rule #4 | step 7 | Always end on a round that has written+saved the output; never finish on an inspection-only round. | BOUNDED — passing tasks already save; additive. |
| 4 | Add example / knowledge #5/#8 | step 5 | Reproduce a shown literal format char-for-char (leading zeros/widths/separators); `01`→`dd`, `05`→`00`. | BOUNDED — fires only when instruction shows a literal sample; 47484 already zero-pads with `"00"` → reinforced. (= cand_0002 edit, which broke nothing.) |
| 5 | Tighten output contract #8 | top block | Exactly one ```python fence, never tool-call XML. | BOUNDED — 4/4 passing tasks emit 0 XML → no action change; only returns a wasted round to fumbling tasks. (= cand_0002 edit, broke nothing.) |
| 6 | Add knowledge #4 (light) | step 2 | "including the subsequent N periods" = anchor + N = N+1 items. | BOUNDED — no passing task uses this phrasing. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per edit)
- 52216: passing trial 1 used two-key SUMIFS (region A14 + expense A16 against cols A & B) → step 3 states exactly that; failing trials t0/t2 read region from a year-int / None cell and matched labels against the region column → step 3 forbids matching a label against a column of different data; all 4 failing trials zeroed the known-good row 15 → step 8's read-back catches it. Passing 53161 already multi-key-matches → unchanged.
- 374-9: every trial aligned Sheet1→Sheet2 by row position; Sheet2 pre-lists state names → step 3 directs lookup on the destination key column. Passing 47484 keys on A+B combo (not position) → reinforced; 418-29 fresh output sheet has no pre-existing keys → rule's trigger not met, unchanged.
- 347-49: failing trials stopped upward scan at row 34 (`Employee Info`), deleting only 1 of 6 blank rows per gap → step 4 says don't stop at a non-blank label; delete every blank in the span. Passing 160-6 has pure blank gaps (rows 6-11), no interspersed labels, and already iterates all rows deleting blanks → identical output.
- 40467: failing t0 `d-mmm`→`1-Jan`; instruction literally shows `01-Jan`; passing t1-4 used `dd-mmm` → step 5 pins char-for-char match. Passing 47484 already uses `"00"` → reinforced.
- Contract: measured wasted rounds this iteration — 32468 5/5, 52216 5/5, 55457 5/5, 40467 3/5, 347-49 3/5, 374-9 2/5; passing 160-6/418-29/47484/53161 = 0/5 each → the rule only affects tasks that already fumble, cannot flip a passing action.

## Process & features used
- 3 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (general-purpose), one per cluster-group; merged findings into one prompt-only candidate. No worktrees needed (single artifact).
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, diff.patch), cand_0002 (REJECTED at Δ+0.020, diff.patch). Re-incorporated BOTH of cand_0002's edits (OUTPUT CONTRACT + format precision) because its RESULT shows broke={} — they were reverted only because the batch's Δ didn't clear the significance bar, so I stack the high-leverage logic fixes (52216/374-9/347-49) on top to clear it.

## PRESERVE (don't let a future iteration undo)
- Do NOT forbid formulas — 40467 passes 3/3 writing an Excel formula (grader recalculates). (cand_0001 refuted.)
- cand_0001's generalization rules (dynamic code, answer_position=write-target, delete_rows shift) — accepted, fixed 160-6/418-29/53161. Kept intact.
- Match-by-key (not by position) and verify-before-finish are the new high-leverage levers.

## Deliberately skipped
- 55457: instruction is a lone nbsp — unwinnable by any general rule; no safe edit.
- 32468 deep boundary logic: only a light general interpretation nudge added (step 2); the exact ground-truth window is per-task and the hidden test values are unavailable, so no stronger edit is verifiable without overfitting.
- tools.py: outside the editable artifact set this iteration.
